scope: M2 read-only prerequisite inspection; M2 implementation and acceptance have not started

findings.fact: Baseline DDL already contains content_blobs, sources, objects, immutable revisions, dependencies, ingestion_imports and jobs. Resume by adding application services; do not recreate baseline.
findings.next: M2.1 atomic blob write, exact content repository, transactional references/current pointer/outbox and read routes.

findings.fact: Current generated API client deliberately rejects path/query and non-JSON response operations.
findings.next: Extend the generator and contract tests when adding content GET routes; retain existing session call compatibility.

findings.fact: Current HTTP boundary aggregates and limits ordinary request bodies to 2 MiB.
findings.next: M2.2 needs a separate bounded streaming upload route with the 50 MiB original-file budget; do not raise every JSON limit.

findings.fact: Import summaries use preview IDs rather than published ContentRefs. Appendix A already declares GET drafts/{id} with kind-specific payload.
findings.next: Bind import preview IDs to restricted draft payloads and source artifacts; show actual proposed content before commit.

findings.fact: Section 5.2 prose uses source_refs/concept_ids, whereas the extractable strict ContentBlock uses citations/concepts.
findings.next: Record the mapping to strict exchange fields, preserving source provenance and concept identity; do not add parallel editable content or silently modify the original specification.

findings.fact: Inline read routes include review_state and reading_state without a complete enum. Published storage status does not prove review or reading.
findings.next: Keep unreviewed/no-evidence states explicit; do not derive approval or learning evidence from successful import.
